title: Astra and Claude Help Solve 11 Squares Packing in Lean
summary:
A team of mathematics researchers used an automated theorem prover to formally verify the optimality of a persistent geometry puzzle. ManassehA06 led the effort to assemble a Lean formalization over several days, using the AI models Astra and Claude to provide a rigorous proof for the optimal packing of 11 squares. The project involved key contributions from Ojoshe, Kleddamag, Wand_125, Guzhou0806, and Ctjlewis.

The finalized proof relies on a strong lower bound developed by Kleddamag, based on earlier work by Wand_125 and Ojoshe. This progression of mathematical refinement improved upon a previous lower bound established by Stromquist23881 in 2003, completing the long-term resolution of the packing problem.

Exciting to see a resolution of the long-standing geometry problem of packing 11 squares.

The proof is layered with an optimality proof and now a Lean formalization from @ManassehA06 assembled over the last few days, with assistance from @ctjlewis @guzhou0806 and others.

It relies on a strong lower bound from @kleddamag built on work from @wand_125 and my lower bound proof, which strengthened the previous lower bound from @stromquist23881 in 2003.

This has been a series of remarkable improvements and proof developments. It's been an honor and a pleasure to see the rapid progress and collaboration.
